examples.method: Source-pinned original PR branch repair. Compare current main to old head, isolate exact one-file overlap, preserve 16 source/test blob hashes, integrate only 19 test/CI additions into byte-exact main workflow; create two-parent fast-forward branch resolution, execute real PR-triggered tests, perform expected-HEAD governed owner merge, and read back native main/merged blobs.
